title: Insured Plan of Care Account Standing and the Patient Payment Plan Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Revenue Cycle standard — standing share of a Patient Payment Plan returned-payment fee**

A standing share follows how the patient settles their Insured Plans of Care: where at least one patient payment was recorded on the patient's plans of care within the last 6 months and no patient statement was issued on any of them in that period, the share is 0.8; where no such payment was recorded and no statement was issued in that period, the share is 0.9; where a statement was issued in that period the standing share is one. The returned-payment fee of the Patient Payment Plan is multiplied by the standing share.

**Records read.** The patient-payment entries and the issued patient-statement entries on every Insured Plan of Care the patient holds, each placed by the date it was recorded; an entry lies within the last 6 months when fewer than 6 whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date.

## Truth table

| Patient payment recorded on an Insured Plan of Care within the last 6 months | Patient statement issued on any of them within the last 6 months | Standing share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 0.8 |
| No | No | 0.9 |
| Yes | Yes | 1 |
| No | Yes | 1 |

## Hypothetical readings (handling date 2026-09-15)

- A patient payment recorded 2026-07-02 on the patient's Insured Plan of Care and the latest statement issued 2026-01-20: share 0.8.
- No patient payment within the last 6 months, and the latest statement issued 2026-03-16: that statement lies within the 6 months (5 whole months), so the share is one. Had it been issued 2026-03-15 (6 whole months), no statement would lie in the period and the share would be 0.9.
